kruk_2024.citation: Kruk ME, Kapoor NR, Lewis TP, et al. Population confidence in the health system in 15 countries: results from the first round of the People’s Voice Survey. Lancet Glob Health. 2024;12(1):e100–e111.
kruk_2024.coverage: 15 country/region surveys; Argentina is Province of Mendoza only. Thai study is separate.
kruk_2024.fieldwork: 2022–2023; the article describes most fieldwork May 9, 2022 to July 16, 2023.
kruk_2024.weighting: Descriptive analyses use sampling and post-stratification weights as applicable. Values are transcribed exactly from Figures 2 and 3, including their Total.
kruk_2024.aggregate_note: Retain Total as the reported 15-country aggregate; do not recompute an arithmetic mean from country labels or add Thailand into it.
kruk_2024.verification: All thirteen metric series were recovered from local legacy plotting dictionaries, then every foreign/Total value visually compared with the primary figure labels. No values inferred from bar lengths, colour, or map shading.
kruk_2024.source_license: Article CC BY 4.0. Only attributed numerical facts are redistributed in this dataset; original figure images are not bundled.

croke_2024.citation: Croke K, Moshabela M, Kapoor NR, et al. Primary health care in practice: usual source of care and health system performance across 14 countries. Lancet Glob Health. 2024;12(1):e134–e144.
croke_2024.coverage: 14 countries/regions; Greece absent, Argentina=Province of Mendoza only
croke_2024.recall: Unmet need for care in the past year, as specified in Measures and analyses
croke_2024.weighting: The study describes post-stratification weights. The reproduced Table 1 is presented as descriptive n (%) and all unmet percentages agree with the displayed counts/sample N to one decimal; these are retained as published, without substituting weighted values from other PVS papers.
croke_2024.aggregate_note: Total is 3296/23230=14.2% from this 14-country Table 1. It is not a 15-country average and does not include Thailand.
croke_2024.verification: The 15 published values (14 countries plus Total), including numerators and sample Ns, were directly parsed and programmatically checked against the primary article XML Table 1.
croke_2024.source_license: PMC XML has conflicting license metadata: copyright-statement says CC BY 4.0, license_ref/license-p says CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. This dataset redistributes attributed numerical facts only; it does not reproduce or adapt the article or its creative figures.
